key.name: language
key.description: ISO 639-1 code of the language to dictate.

key.name: model
key.description: Registry id of the model to use; empty means the first model registered for the language.

key.name: end-silence
key.description: Seconds of silence after speech before listening stops.

key.name: postprocess
key.summary: Capitalise and add a final period

key.name: key-delay
key.description: Milliseconds between two simulated key presses.

key.name: restore-token
key.description: Lets the keyboard permission persist across restarts.
